messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert — page fired: HIGH runtime.latency.p50 > 1200ms (service=runtime-prod)
incident-bot: Triggered by policy: runtime-p50-latency | threshold=1200ms | eval_window=1m
Ash (oncall): acked — taking lead :wave:
Matt: oncall pinged, looking at grafana now
Sanjay: I can see a sharp spike in the inference queue length and mem pressure for nodes in us-east-1a
Leah: any customer-facing 5xxs? quick check on prod-errors shows a small bump in 502s starting ~14:19 UTC
Ash (oncall): running quick checks:
```
kubectl -n runtime get pods -o wide | grep serving
kubectl top nodes | grep us-east-1a
```
Ash (oncall): found 4 pods in CrashLoopBackOff and a couple with OOMKilled in last 10m
Matt: logs show repeated `ModelShardNotReady` from model-variant `gpt-medium-q4` around the same time — looks like a hot shard
Sanjay: autoscaler didn't react fast enough because cpu usage was fine — memory pressure + bursting batch queue prevented new pods from passing readiness
ops-bot: deploy-bot: last deploy: release-2026-03-12-09 @matt (no automated rollbacks)
Ash (oncall): manual mitigation: increased replicas from 20 -> 30 temporarily and forced restart of the 4 crashloop pods
Ash (oncall): ran `kubectl rollout restart deployment/serving` for the affected pool
Matt: also applied an override to the HPA to lower target memory threshold to 60% for the group: `kubectl patch hpa serving -p '{"spec":{"metrics":[...]}}'` (logged in incident ticket)
Sanjay: after scale + restart, queue length is dropping, p50 coming down from ~1.4s to ~450ms over last 2m
Leah: customer impact assessment — brief: ~1.2% of requests in the 14:18-14:25 window saw >2s latency, 502s rose by ~0.15% (no SLA breaches observed in summary checks)
incident-bot: Alert auto-resolved — condition cleared (runtime.latency.p50 < 1200ms)
Ash (oncall): marking this as likely flapping/noisy alert — transient mem pressure on model shard. Creating follow-up: INC-1234 with logs and timeline
Matt: suggested action items: 1) ramp HPA memory sensitivity for this pool, 2) add KV-cache hit rate to the alert rule so cache thrash doesn't fire this, 3) add model-shard readiness errors as a separate alert with higher window
Sanjay: also propose a short circuit-breaker on that model variant so traffic falls back to `gpt-medium` base variant when shard reports not-ready
Leah: noted for customer comms: no broad impact, watch 24h for recurrence; we'll include metrics in RCA
Ash (oncall): oncall handoff note: keep an eye on us-east-1a nodes and the serving pool for the next 24h; escalation plan if recurrence > 2 in 1h
Matt: will follow up with a small postmortem and link to the ticket. good catch and quick mitigation everyone :thumbsup:
Sanjay: thanks — leaving a couple of datapoints in the ticket about batch sizes and sequence lengths that appear correlated
ops-bot: created ticket INC-1234 (https://jira.internal/redwood/INC-1234) with severity P3 and action list
Ash (oncall): closing thread from oncall perspective. please comment in the ticket for follow-ups. :lock_with_ink_pen:
